verdict.rationale: Brex's developer docs state that the Payments API can manage vendors and send ACH, domestic wires, and checks. Bill pay is listed as a core platform capability, and vendor payments can also be automated through Pipedream and AI-powered invoice payment workflows. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the in-app finance-lead workflow for initiating ACH/wire vendor payments (approvals, limits, timing), and independent or hands-on corroboration that these payments work as claimed.
